applies_why: The judge text does not count any verse on a cited-in line as an unanswered witness toward a broken link; it labels the issue underdetermined and records that both sides answered.
quote: the defender answered the beget-pattern and naming witnesses in [CR3] LINK 4 and [CR2] §5, and the challenger answered hēs in [DR3] C2.
rule_words: If the judge says a verse was answered, the judge must not count it. Not counting it obeys this rule.
why: Since the judge says the challenger answered hēs and does not count it toward a broken link, it obeys K-G4.
